mail.oauth.anbieter-fehlt: For signing in via OAuth please choose Microsoft 365 or Google.
mail.oauth.server: With OAuth, Ablago only sends to the provider’s server: {server}.
mail.oauth.verschluesselt: OAuth only with encryption (SSL/TLS or STARTTLS).
mail.oauth.benutzer: With OAuth the user is the account’s email address.
mail.oauth.nicht-eingerichtet: Sign-in via OAuth is not set up.
mail.oauth.erst-speichern: Please save “Sign-in via OAuth” first and then sign in with the provider.
mail.fehler.microsoft-oauth: Microsoft doesn’t allow sign-in with a password here. Use sign-in via Microsoft (OAuth).
mail.fehler.app-passwort: Google requires an app password instead of the normal password.
mail.fehler.passwort: Wrong password or app password needed. With some providers, sending via SMTP must first be enabled in the settings.
mail.fehler.oauth: The provider refused the sign-in via OAuth. Sign in again and check whether the app may allow sending (Microsoft: SMTP.Send).
mail.fehler.anmeldung-noetig: The server requires a sign-in. Please enter user and password.
mail.fehler.absender: The server doesn’t allow this sender. Use the account’s address as the sender.
mail.fehler.verbindungsart: The connection type doesn’t fit the port: 465 belongs to SSL/TLS, 587 to STARTTLS.
mail.fehler.zertifikat: The server’s certificate isn’t trustworthy. Is the server name right? For your own server in the home network, “Allow self-signed certificate” helps.
mail.fehler.unbekannt: There is no server with this name. Please check the name.
mail.fehler.zeit: The server doesn’t answer. Please check server and port; perhaps a firewall blocks the port.
mail.fehler.verbindung: No connection to the server. Please check server, port and connection type.
mail.fehler.tls: The encrypted connection couldn’t be established. Please check connection type and port.
mail.fehler.abgebrochen: The connection broke off. Does the connection type fit the port?
mail.fehler.sonst: The server refused. The response is below.
mail.unter: For invitations, “Forgot password”, the daily summary and notices about a changed email address or password. Without email sending, user management shows the links for copying.
mail.adresse: Which email address should Ablago write from?
mail.adresse.hilfe: Ideally an address of its own for Ablago. From it the assistant suggests server, user and sender.
mail.passwort.gesetzt: set – leave empty to keep it
mail.passwort.verschluesselt: The password is stored encrypted. Ablago keeps the key for it in a file of its own, not in the database.
mail.passwort.unverschluesselt: The password saved so far is still unencrypted in the database.
mail.passwort.unlesbar: The saved password was encrypted with a different key that no longer exists and can’t be read. Please enter it again.
mail.schluessel-fehlt: A password can only be saved once there is a key.
mail.anmeldung.spaeter: You set up sign-in via OAuth after setup under Workbench → Email and address. It needs an app at the provider.
mail.quelle.liste: from the list of known providers
mail.quelle.mx: recognised from your domain’s mail server
mail.nicht-gefunden.text: Enter server and port under “Advanced”; they are usually in your provider’s help.
mail.gefragt: Asked for this: {wen} – only with the domain, without address and password.
mail.ohne-netz: Without a network call: from the built-in list.
mail.thunderbird: Look up in the Thunderbird database
mail.thunderbird.text: Only the domain {domain} goes to autoconfig.thunderbird.net (Mozilla).
mail.hinweis.freischalten: With {anbieter} you first have to enable sending via SMTP in the mailbox settings (allow POP3/IMAP and SMTP).
mail.hinweis.app-passwort: {anbieter} needs an app password, not the normal password. You create it in the account settings of {anbieter}.
mail.hinweis.tonline: With T-Online you need the email password from the customer centre, not the password for the login.
mail.hinweis.microsoft: Microsoft is switching off password sign-in for SMTP (Exchange Online end of December 2026). Use sign-in via Microsoft (OAuth).
mail.selbstsigniert.hilfe: Only for your own mail server in the home network; otherwise leave it switched off.
mail.testen: Test – with the values above, even unsaved
mail.oauth.angemeldet: Signed in with the provider. Test with “Check connection”.
mail.oauth.abmelden.text: Ablago deletes the stored tokens. Until the new sign-in Ablago sends no emails.
mail.oauth.app.gilt: the same app as for the mailboxes
mail.oauth.app.microsoft: At Microsoft the app additionally needs the permission SMTP.Send (Office 365 Exchange Online). Ablago only sends the token to smtp.office365.com or smtp-mail.outlook.com.
mail.oauth.app.google: At Google the scope https://mail.google.com/ applies to fetching and sending. Ablago only sends the token to smtp.gmail.com.
absenderbereinigen.das-feld-absender-ist: The “From” field is empty afterwards. The history of each post records what was in it before.
absenderbereinigen.bei-posts-ist-der_one: “From” of one post is now empty.
absenderbereinigen.bis-version-0-99: Up to version 0.99, uploaded post without a sender had the name of whoever created it in the “From” field (then “Sender”; for the intake folder “Intake folder”). Here you find these posts and clear the field. Post from mailboxes and sent emails aren’t included.
absenderbereinigen.nichts-zu-bereinigen-: Nothing to clean up – no post has the name of its creator under “From”.
absenderbereinigen.posts-haben-vermutlic: One post probably has a wrong name under “From”. Remove the tick where it is right after all.
{anzahl} posts probably have a wrong name under “From”. Remove the tick where it is right after all.
postfaecher.die-anmeldung-ist-abgelaufen: The sign-in has expired or is unknown. Please start again.
postfaecher.die-anmeldung-wurde-in: The sign-in was started in a different browser. Please start again.
postfaecher.der-anbieter-hat-die: The provider refused the sign-in, or it was cancelled. Details are in the log.
postfaecher.der-anbieter-hat-keinen: The provider delivered no code. Please start again.
postfaecher.der-anbieter-hat-keine: The provider issued no sign-in. Details are in the log.
postfaecher.beim-anbieter-angemeldet-mit: Signed in with the provider. Check with “Test connection”.
postfaecher.mails-abholen-jede-mail: Fetch mail – every mail becomes new post.
postfaecher.server-port-oder-verschluess: Server, port or encryption changed: please save first and then sign in again with the provider.
Server, port or encryption changed: please enter the password again – the saved one only goes to the saved server.
postfaecher.die-mails-im-postfach: The mails in the mailbox stay as they are.
postfaecher.am-besten-ein-eigenes: Ideally a mailbox of its own or a forwarding, e.g. {code} – not your private main mailbox. Many providers require an {b} or sign-in via {b2}, see manual.
postfaecher.name: Name
postfaecher.gespeichert-leer-lassen-um: saved – leave empty to keep it
postfaecher.adressen-oder-domains-durch: Addresses or domains, separated by commas; empty = all
postfaecher.ohne-verschluesselung-gehen-: Without encryption, password and mails go over the network in plain text.
postfaecher.zustand.aus: Off – Ablago does not fetch this mailbox.
postfaecher.der-geraetecode-ist-abgelauf: The device code has expired. Please request a new one.
postfaecher.ablago-loescht-die-gespeiche: Ablago deletes the stored tokens and fetches no mail from this mailbox until the new sign-in.
postfaecher.dann-ist-ein-einfacher: {b} Then an {b2} is simpler. A Google app of your own in “Testing” status must be signed in again every 7 days; without this limit it only works within Google Workspace (“internal”) or after Google’s review.
postfaecher.gilt-fuer-alle-postfaecher: applies to all mailboxes of this provider
postfaecher.wird-verschluesselt-gespeich: stored encrypted; empty for public clients
postfaecher.common-consumers-nur-outlook: common, consumers (only Outlook.com), organizations or tenant ID
postfaecher.mit-leerzeichen-getrennt-mei: separated by spaces, usually including offline_access
postfaecher.ohne-https-geht-die: – without https, sign-in in the browser doesn’t work (except via localhost)
postfaecher.oder-mit-geraetecode-anmelde: – or sign in with a device code
postfaecher.erst-nach-eintrag-der: only after entering the address under {link}{wert}
postfaecher.erst-das-postfach-speichern: Save the mailbox first, then sign in with the provider here.
postfaecher.abgelaufen-oder-entzogen-bit: expired or revoked – please sign in again
postfaecher.oeffne-auf-einem-beliebigen: Open {link} on any device and enter this code: {b}. Valid until {zeit}. This page waits until you have signed in.
postfaecher.ohne-adresse-von-ablago: Without Ablago’s address only with a device code
postfaecher.nur-mit-https-adresse: Only with an https address for Ablago – otherwise with a device code
postfaecher.mit-geraetecode-anmelden: Sign in with a device code
